title: GithubWebhook
description: GitHub App webhook configuration and delivery status.

configured.description: Whether the webhook secret is configured.

last_delivery_at.description: When the last verified delivery was received.

dropped_deliveries.description: Verified deliveries dropped for untracked repositories, installation-wide, since the last restart, at most 14 days.

refused_connections.description: TCP connections refused at the webhook listener's capacity limit since the last restart.
